followup: Both followup full unit reports verify all nine commit lifecycle controls and the host failure projections. Failure reporting retains event ownership until diagnostics finish; receipt retirement runs exactly once in finally. Build/stdout fixture observations now wait for owner retirement. Five unresolved failures remain: four debt controls and private earned verdict.
limits: PrepareCommit remains None for TestPrune; production debt migration is unapplied pending explicit approval following automatic review rejection. Common supervision/deadline qualification for commit hooks, full CI, consumer qualification and private earned verdict remain unfinished. Unit/integration reports do not establish an exact-tree full gate or deployed runtime claim.
